entries.en:
The Adventurers' Guild investigator relates to you his plight: as All Saints' Eve approaches, a shifty figure known as the Scarlet Snout has been making the rounds about Gridania, unsettling the local populace. Sadly, the investigator's best efforts have turned up little in the way of leads as to what this individual is up to. At his behest, you agree to aid him in his quest by inquiring among the locals in hopes of learning more about this red-nosed ruffian.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.

entries.en: Through your inquiries with the townspeople─some more cooperative than others─it soon becomes apparent that the Scarlet Snout has made contact with several individuals, inviting more than a few of them to a banquet of sorts. Concerned for their fate, you begin to make your way back to Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre to relate to the guild investigator all that has transpired.
entries.fr: Vous avez fini de rassembler les témoignages des villageois concernant l'homme au nez rouge. Allez en informer l'enquêteur de la guilde des aventuriers qui se trouve devant l'amphithéâtre de Mih Khetto.
entries.ja: 市民たちから奇妙な赤っ鼻の男の目撃情報を集めた。ミィ・ケット野外音楽堂前にいる「冒険者ギルドの調査員」に調査結果を報告しよう。

entries.en: After conferring with the investigator, you agree that the best course of action is for you to attempt to initiate contact with the Scarlet Snout yourself. At your client's behest, you set out to lie in wait by the river near the Leatherworkers' Guild until the man with the protuberant proboscis approaches you.
entries.fr: Vous avez expliqué la situation à l'enquêteur, et décidé que vous deviez faire en sorte de rencontrer le mystérieux homme au nez rouge vous-même. Attendez qu'il apparaisse à l'endroit indiqué, près de la guilde des tanneurs.
entries.ja: 冒険者ギルドの調査員に調査結果を報告した。奇妙な赤っ鼻の男と直接会うため、おとり捜査を行うことになった。革細工師ギルド付近の「<sheet(EObj,2011283,0)>」で待機し、赤っ鼻の男の出現を待とう。

entries.en: Sure enough, the so-called Scarlet Snout─now revealed to be an itinerant clown by the name of Papa Gruff─finds you and extends an invitation to his banquet, much as he did with the other residents of Gridania. Unable to yet discern whether he means well or ill, you head back to the Leatherworkers' Guild to inform the investigator of your meeting and discuss your next course of action.
entries.fr: Vous avez discuté avec l'homme au nez rouge. Retournez parler à l'enquêteur qui vous attend près de la guilde des tanneurs.
entries.ja: パパ・ブルーセと話した。革細工師ギルド付近にいる「冒険者ギルドの調査員」に話した内容を報告しよう。

entries.en: Hearing your story, the Adventurers' Guild investigator is duly suspicious, but nevertheless suggests playing along with your quarry, that you might obtain more concrete information. So it is that you make for Bentbranch Meadows, where you will seek out a vantage point a stone's throw from the agreed-upon location, that you might spy upon Papa Gruff and his interactions with his other guests from a safe distance.
entries.fr: Vous avez raconté à l'enquêteur votre rencontre avec l'homme au nez rouge. Rendez-vous à l'endroit indiqué, dans la Forêt centrale, pour surveiller de loin ses agissements.
entries.ja: 冒険者ギルドの調査員に話した内容を報告した。さらに調査を進めるため、中央森林の「<sheet(EObj,2011284,0)>」に行き、パパ・ブルーセの様子を探ろう。

entries.en: As you survey the scene, it does not take long for the entire Gruff clan to appear. A chill runs up your spine as you overhear them discussing their dark plot to realize something called the Night of Devilry by feeding on the fear and life energies of their guests. Somewhat shaken, you decide to return to the investigator and elucidate to him this rather disturbing turn of events.
entries.fr: Vous avez trouvé l'homme et sa famille, qui se sont révélés être des monstres dont le but était le retour de la Nuit des démons. Allez vite faire part de ce que vous avez appris à l'enquêteur.
entries.ja: パパ・ブルーセの様子を探った。彼らは一家で「魔人の夜」の再現を目論んでいることがわかった。ベントブランチ牧場にいる「冒険者ギルドの調査員」に報告しよう。

entries.en: The investigator is to no small degree concerned, but at the same time assures you that the Adventurers' Guild has sent aid in the form of an expert on all matters occult. Going off to see to your preparations, you agree to return to the investigator when you are ready to meet the man in question and see what perfect plan he has devised.
entries.fr: Vous avez informé l'enquêteur de ce que vous aviez appris. Il vous a ensuite expliqué qu'un spécialiste des créatures démoniaques et phénomènes étranges avait été dépêché pour vous prêter main-forte. Adressez de nouveau la parole à l'enquêteur enfin d'en savoir plus.

entries.en: As you can well see from the decorations about town, All Saints' Wake is nearly upon us. And I am pleased to report that this year, at least, I have seen no sign of those fiends from the Continental Circus as of yet.
entries.fr: La saison de la Veillée des saints approche... et avec elle l'arrivée du Cirque intercontinental. Et pourtant, j'ai beau être à l'affut, toujours aucune trace des saltimbanques<nbsp>!

entries.en: The people of Eorzea know them as a traveling troupe of entertainers who visit whenever All Saints' Wake is upon us. However, in actuality they are a band of voidsent fiends in disguise.
entries.fr: Ce sont des saltimbanques qui rappliquent chaque année en Éorzéa lorsqu'approche la saison de la Veillée des saints. Mais attention, ils ont une sacrée particularité... Ce sont tous des monstres<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
守護天節の季節になると、
エオルゼアへとやってくる旅芸人の一座のことです。
しかし、ここだけの話……彼らは人に化けた魔物でしてね。

entries.en: That is not to say they get up to anything that goes beyond the realm of mere mischief. No, they are generally harmless, which is why I have been content to observe them from afar. Bizarrely I am yet to see any sign of them this time round despite the festivities being so close at hand.
entries.fr: Rassurez-vous cependant, ils n'ont jamais rien fait de mal, mais je préfère rester dans l'ombre pour les surveiller au cas où. Sauf que là, toujours aucun monstre à l'horizon<nbsp>!

entries.en: See, I've heard that he's a well-heeled bloke who loves nothing more than to share his fortune with his friends. Ever since then, I've been searching high and low for him. Even if I did know anything, damned if I'm going to share it with anyone!

entries.en: But how to commemorate our newfound friendship? Oh, but of course! Why don't you join me at my humble abode for a feast? I swear, you haven't lived until you've been to one of my banquets!

贅を尽くしたもてなしで、アナタを歓迎させてもらうよ！

entries.en: Anyroad, come meet me under the Bentbranch Meadows bridge whenever you're ready, and I'd be more than happy to show you the way to my home. Well, ta ta for now!

entries.en: So that was our man, was it? I must say, his appearance was every bit as...distinctive as the rumors said. Pray tell, did he invite you to his feast as he did the others?
entries.fr: Vous avez réussi à trouver l'homme au nez rouge, alors<nbsp>? Il vous a invité<if(gnum4,e,)> au banquet<nbsp>?

あれが噂の赤っ鼻の男……！
どうでしたか？　やはり、饗宴に誘ってきましたか！？

entries.en: ...I had a feeling this was how things might play out. While his actions are most suspicious, it is impossible to tell exactly what his goal is, and whether or not he has any malicious intent.
entries.fr: Je vois... Ça concorde avec tous les témoignages, et c'est diablement suspect<nbsp>! Je me demande bien ce que ce clown manigance...

なるほど……証言者の状況と一致しますね。
しかし、怪しいことこの上ありませんが、
何を企んでいるのかまでは……。

entries.en: I suppose our best option is to play along for the time being. Might I ask you to head to Bentbranch Meadows and observe things from a safe distance? If it seems the Snout is up to no good, we'll put a stop to it straightaway.
entries.fr: Puisque c'est ainsi, nous allons nous mettre en embuscade près de l'endroit du rendez-vous et observer comment il se comporte avec ses “invités”. Et au moindre mouvement suspect, nous interviendrons<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
こうなったら、指定された待ち合わせ場所に赴き、
少し離れた場所から、様子をうかがってみていただけますか？
そして、犯罪行為が行われるようなら、阻止するんです！

entries.en: I myself shall first return to the Adventurers' Guild in order to deliver my report. Let us rendezvous at our destination when we both are ready.
entries.fr: Je vous rejoindrai dès que j'aurai fait mon rapport à la guilde des aventuriers. Rendez-vous dès que possible au ranch de Brancharquée.
entries.ja:
私は冒険者ギルドに、捜査状況を報告してから向かいます。
後ほど、中央森林のベントブランチ牧場で合流しましょう！

entries.en: Heh. Just think of all those innocent fools sauntering casually to our abode...blissfully unaware that they are, in fact, marching towards their doom.
entries.fr: Aucun d'entre eux ne se doute que dès qu'ils mettront le pied chez nous ils ne pourront plus jamais en sortir...

……我らが饗宴にノコノコ参加する者共も、
まさか、足を踏み入れたが最後、
永遠に帰れないとは思ってもないだろう……。

entries.fr: Tous ces pauvres innocents ne se doutent pas un instant de la terreur qui attend leurs âmes quand nous leur volerons...
entries.ja:
タマシイを抜き取られるだなんて思ってもない、
カワイイ、無垢なヒトたち……！

そして、タマシイから集めた恐怖の力で、
同胞たちを呼び寄せ、魔物による混沌の饗宴を開く……！
